skill.name: gpt-image-edit
skill.description: Edit existing images with OpenAI GPT Image 2 through the RunComfy CLI, using structured prompts for preservation, text changes, layout edits, and multi-reference compositions.
skill.summary: Edit images with GPT Image 2 on RunComfy using preservation-focused prompts.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: The high-volume static hits are mostly markdown backticks, placeholder URLs, and relative documentation links rather than executable code or path traversal. The real risks are disclosed use of the RunComfy CLI, third-party network processing, generated output downloads, and local token storage.

remediation.issue: Third-party processing of prompts and image URLs
remediation.suggestion: Add a concise marketplace warning that prompts, image URLs, and generated assets are sent to RunComfy and may be processed outside the local machine.
Keep the token-storage disclosure and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI or ephemeral environments.
Tell users to install the RunComfy CLI from the official package source and review commands before execution.

content.value_statement: Image edits often fail when prompts do not protect identity, layout, or embedded text. This skill gives Claude and other agents a structured RunComfy workflow for precise GPT Image 2 edits.
actual_capabilities: Runs GPT Image 2 image editing through the RunComfy CLI.
Provides prompt patterns for preserving faces, products, brands, and layouts.
Supports edits with up to 10 publicly reachable image references.
Guides multilingual in-image text replacement with quoted target text.
Documents size choices, exit codes, and common request failures.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account and local RunComfy CLI setup.
Input images must be available through HTTPS URLs.
Long compound edit prompts can reduce output consistency.
Batch SKU work may be better served by a different image-edit model.

use_cases.title: Localize marketing images
use_cases.description: Replace headlines or labels in product images while preserving layout, brand marks, and visual style.

use_cases.title: Create controlled product variants
use_cases.description: Change backgrounds, framing, or scene context while keeping the subject identity stable.

use_cases.title: Prototype multi-reference compositions
use_cases.description: Combine a subject from one image with lighting, palette, or environment cues from other references.

prompt_templates.title: Basic preservation edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when changing one visual element in a source image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gpt-image-edit to keep the subject, pose, and framing unchanged. Replace the background with a clean studio setting.

prompt_templates.title: Translate image text
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when updating text inside an existing design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gpt-image-edit to keep the photograph, layout, lighting, and brand mark unchanged. Replace only the headline with the exact text I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Compose from references
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when combining visual cues from several source images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gpt-image-edit with image 1 as the subject and image 2 as the environment. Match the lighting and color palette of image 2.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a precise edit workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a complex edit needs multiple controlled passes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a GPT Image 2 edit using gpt-image-edit. Split the request into safe steps, preserve identity and layout, and identify the best size setting.

output_examples.input: Replace the English poster headline with Japanese text while keeping the design unchanged.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a preservation-first edit prompt, names the target script, quotes the replacement text, and routes the request through RunComfy.

output_examples.input: Move a product photo into a warm kitchen scene using a second reference image.
output: Defines image 1 as the product source.
Defines image 2 as the scene reference.
Requests matched lighting and color while preserving the product.

output_examples.input: Change the background of a portrait without changing the person.
output_examples.output: The skill emphasizes face, pose, clothing, and framing preservation before describing the new background.

best_practices: Start prompts with what must remain unchanged before describing the edit.
Quote exact replacement text and name the writing system for text edits.
Use size auto unless the requested edit changes the image framing.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated changes in one prompt.
Do not use private or sensitive image URLs without approval for third-party processing.
Do not omit preservation details when faces, products, or brand marks matter.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It is focused on editing existing images through the GPT Image 2 edit endpoint.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. Users need the RunComfy CLI and either login credentials or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN value.

faq.question: Can it edit text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for exact text replacement, including non-Latin scripts.

faq.question: How many reference images can it use?
faq.answer: The documented endpoint accepts up to 10 publicly reachable HTTPS image URLs.

faq.question: Are images processed locally?
faq.answer: No. The skill sends requests to RunComfy, and the model server fetches referenced image URLs.
